values.note: Campspot's RV categories hold 43 sites: 6 'Big Rig' paved pull-through full hookups (to 40 ft), 9 pull-through full hookups (35 ft), 3 back-in full hookups (Class A to 30 ft, fifth wheels to 25 ft), 20 water-electric RV/pop-up sites to 25 ft and 5 pop-up sites to 22 ft. Tent sites and cabins besides.

values.note: Book online through Campspot, choosing the site. The rules page says 'Any specific site requested requires the following minimum reservations: Weekends: 2 nights, Holidays: 3 nights', but Campspot sold one-night Saturday stays on every RV type (2027-06-19, read 2026-10-13), so it is not a standing minimum. A site-lock fee guarantees the reserved site. Cancel 30+ days out for a refund less $50; 50% refund at 14-29 days, 25% at 7-13, none inside 7. Book six nights, the seventh is free. Must be 21 to reserve.

summary: Fees stand (Campspot June 2027 $52.92-103.95 + $6 per stay, recorded 2026-10-13). Added 50/30-amp full hookups, 43 RV sites to 40 ft with pull-throughs, showers/dump/laundry/store/Wi-Fi, Campspot booking with the cancellation tiers; the rules page's 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum applies to a specific-site request and Campspot sold one-night Saturdays, so it went in the note, not min_stay. Not stated: season (inclusion_evidence's mid-April - October is not on today's pages), booking window, flush toilets.
